_README: Hand-curated seed projects. These exist so the globe has real, recognisable content before the networked adapters are wired up. EVERY record produced from this file is tagged 'unverified' and rendered with a caution badge. Costs and dates are approximate figures from public reporting, rounded, and are NOT authoritative - the whole point of the networked adapters is to replace them with primary-source values carrying real provenance. source_url points at the official project or agency landing page a human can check; deep links arrive with the real adapters.
